title: Zardis's age and the Seven Ward
summary: Born about 1900, he joined at about 17. He locates the Seven Ward and Buddy's birthplace.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Yeah. Now, what can you, what year were you born?
1900. And can you, approximately how old were you when, when Billy Marrera came up to you and asked if you joined Buddy's band?
Well, I was around, say, about 17 years old.
I see. Now, where was this, where is the Seven Ward?
The Seven Ward, that's between, uh, Espinade and Lichenfield.
Oh, I see. That's where Buddy was born?
That's where Buddy was born. Is the, I think it's, uh, 17, in the 1700 blocks in Atman Street. That's where he will live in that. Yeah. Between D'Oibany and Rowan.
